title: Netanyahu Says Israel and Hamas Are on the Brink of a Hostage Deal
summary: Both sides have reacted positively to a United States proposal for a cease-fire, but many details remained to be worked out, including whether Hamas would disarm.

title: At a Protest for a Deal, Israelis Wrestle With a Mix of Emotions
summary: Along with optimism that President Trump can lock Israel and Hamas into a deal, many expressed anxiety about being disappointed once more.
